SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-29-2020 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-29-2020 BY A. JAMES ROBERTSON II. PLAINTIFF SHAHLA KHAILTASH IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ISSA ESHIMA MD IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-29-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KHAILTASH, SHAHLA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT ESHIMA MD, ISSA COURT FINDS PLAINTIFF FAILED TO PROVE HER CLAIM THAT DEFENDANT REPRESENTATIONS AS TO USING PATIENT'S FAT IN SURGERY WERE FALSE.
